A contains-only union view borrows child domains for bounded disabled admission. Input mapping reuses Listbox; effect frames are fenced by accepted cursors, interaction and revision. Retirement clears hooks/policies/disabled/completion even when update throws.

fullScan.rationale: Explicit node replacement and complete move output use Core admission; ordinary same-domain navigation borrows canonical state without selected normalization.

Canonical cursor updates project at most four rows and two roots; unchanged attributes perform no writes. Two-pane accepted/refused and synchronously accepted moves, unmounted active descendants, nested controls, replaced rows, acquisition/cleanup exceptions, suspend/resume churn and held-handle root/payload GC exercise the public connection.

contract.proof: One map retains at most one mounted row per source identity. Registration/release has expected constant index work and projects one row. Explicit render visits exactly registered rows and projects canonical Core depth/selection/expansion; no source traversal or portable reducer exists here. Layer, visibility and position resources reuse their existing owners. Disconnect clears the scope before draining all cleanup; only portable source/last snapshot survive. Native hooks and platform references are collectible with facade and saved methods held. Facade destroy separately retires its shared subscriber/application-update scope. Native observation defers only value correction through one coalesced generation-guarded microtask and one pending query string. Settlement compares the accepted query in O(q), without revisiting mounted rows or repeating layout work; unbind invalidates the pending correction. Native string materialization is conservatively included in allocation cost.
contract.adversarialWitness: Initial request activates once over detach/reattach and suspension. IME query commits, stale responses, source-branch refusal, mounted active descendant release, failed initial transport cleanup and held-handle GC.

fullScan.rationale: Explicit host projection visits m mounted rows, never the entire unmounted source domain. Platform layout resources and semantic transitions have separate owners/bounds.

contract.proof: Retire input before clearing the fixed callback/policy/completion scope and disabled-ID reference in finally. Existing interaction state refuses future writes. There is no DOM connection or platform resource in this controller prerequisite.

contract.proof: The resolved host adapter turns browser events into the same generation-guarded transaction. contract.resourceRationale: Ordinary scroll reuses the connection frame and replaces only the current emitted placement index. Element mode retains one scroll listener; document mode retains one scroll listener plus one constant viewport-resize listener outside the scroll loop.
contract.proof: Construction resolves stable host operations once. Document mode neither rereads the surface rectangle nor reads document scroll range on this path.
contract.adversarialWitness: At 1, 8, and 32 same-document connections, a burst of page-scroll events schedules at most one frame per connection; each accepted frame performs no surface geometry/range read and one query, then disconnect releases every listener and pending frame.

fullScan.rationale: Ordinary scroll may process emitted placements only, never mounted elements or the full logical domain.
